items.exampleEn: The children sat docilely while the photographer set up his camera.
items.exampleZh: 攝影師架設相機時，孩子們乖乖地坐著。

items.exampleEn: The film's final scene was gruesomely realistic.
items.exampleZh: 那部電影的最後一幕逼真得令人毛骨悚然。
items.glossZh: 駭人地；令人毛骨悚然地

items.exampleEn: The hotel room was inexcusably dirty for the price.
items.exampleZh: 以這個價格來說，飯店房間髒得實在說不過去。
items.glossZh: 不可原諒地；說不過去地

items.exampleEn: The lion lay lethargically in the shade all afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 那頭獅子整個下午都懶洋洋地躺在樹蔭下。

items.exampleEn: His naivety about money made him easy to fool.
items.exampleZh: 他對金錢的天真，讓他很容易被騙。

items.exampleEn: Nurses often work gruelling twelve-hour shifts.
items.exampleZh: 護理師常要輪十二小時、累死人的班。

items.exampleEn: The small café is beguilingly simple, with just five tables.
items.exampleZh: 那家小咖啡館簡單得迷人，只有五張桌子。

items.sentenceEn: The long line moved lethargically toward the ticket office.
items.sentenceZh: 長長的隊伍慢吞吞地朝售票處移動。

items.audioEn: The students listened lethargically to the last lecture of the day.
items.audioZh: 學生們懶洋洋地聽著當天最後一堂課。
items.questionZh: 學生們聽最後一堂課時的狀態如何？

items.sentenceEn: The test was gruelling, but I learned a lot from it.
items.sentenceZh: 那次考驗很累人，但我從中學到很多。

items.sentenceEn: She smiled beguilingly and asked for one more chance.
items.sentenceZh: 她迷人地笑了笑，請求再給她一次機會。

items.stemEn: The puppy followed its owner ____ through the crowded market.
items.stemZh: 小狗乖乖地跟著主人穿過擁擠的市場。

items.stemEn: In my ____, I believed everything the salesman told me.
items.stemZh: 我太天真了，業務員說什麼我都相信。

items.passageEn: Last autumn, I joined a gruelling three-day hike across the mountains to raise money for a children's hospital. In my naivety, I thought it would be like a long walk in the park. By the second morning, we were moving lethargically, and even our guide's dog followed docilely behind us instead of running ahead. The trail, which had looked beguilingly easy on the map, rose sharply for hours and tested our toughness. One member had inexcusably forgotten to pack the poles for the tents, so we slept under a plastic sheet. Around the fire, our guide told gruesomely detailed ghost stories to keep us awake. We finished tired but proud.
items.passageZh: 去年秋天，我參加了一趟為兒童醫院募款、橫越山區的三天健行，非常累人。我天真地以為這就像在公園裡散一段長長的步。到了第二天早上，大家都走得有氣無力，連嚮導的狗都乖乖跟在後面，不再往前跑。地圖上看起來簡單得誘人的步道，實際上連續陡升好幾個小時，考驗著我們的韌性。有位隊員竟然忘了帶帳篷的支架，實在說不過去，我們只好睡在一張塑膠片下面。圍著營火，嚮導講了細節駭人的鬼故事，讓我們保持清醒。我們走完全程時雖然很累，卻很驕傲。

questions.questionZh: 作者一開始以為這趟健行會怎樣？
options: 像在公園裡散一段長長的步

questions.questionZh: 為什麼他們只能睡在塑膠片下？
options: 營地突然下起大雨，帳篷全被吹走
有人忘了帶帳篷的支架

items.promptZh: 他遲到得太離譜，實在不可原諒，而且連一句道歉也沒有。
referenceEn: He arrived inexcusably late and didn't even say sorry.
He was inexcusably late, and he did not even apologize.
rubricZh: 「遲到得不可原諒」用 inexcusably 修飾 late（例如 inexcusably late）
「連一句道歉也沒有」可寫，例如 didn't even say sorry、did not even apologize 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 arrived、was）

items.instructionZh: 用 gruelling 造一個句子，描述一次讓你非常累的經驗。
referenceEn: I had a gruelling day of exams and went to bed at eight.
Moving house in the summer heat was gruelling for me.
rubricZh: gruelling 是形容詞，例如放名詞前（a gruelling day）、be 動詞後（was gruelling）等；美式拼法 grueling 也正確
說的是自己的經驗，時態配合內容（例如 had、was）
內容和自己有關（例如 I、for me）
